attributes.name: Monkey
attributes.description:
MONKEY

Born from the wildest, most absurd meme sweeping Douyin (China’s TikTok), MONKEY is pure internet satire turned into a coin.

On Douyin, “Monkey Coin” exploded with hundreds of millions of views. People joked about infinite supply, numbers with dozens of zeros, massive free airdrops, and exchange rates so ridiculous that even a googol of Monkey Coins was only worth a pile of chicken manure. It mocked the entire crypto cycle: missing BTC and DOGE, chasing the next 100x, FOMO, pump-and-dumps, and the pure belief that “someone will buy higher.”

At its core, the meme is a mirror. It shows how most meme coins have no real utility — their value exists only because enough people believe in the joke. When the belief dies, the price dies with it. It’s funny, brutal, and painfully accurate.

MONKEY takes that exact energy from Chinese internet culture and brings it on-chain. No fake utility, no corporate roadmap — just the raw, chaotic, community-driven spirit of the original Douyin meme. The more people share the joke, the stronger the narrative becomes.

Because in the end, the craziest memes are the ones that turn pure nonsense into consensus.

We are all monkeys now. 🐒

BB84 brings quantum safe culture and next gen security straight to Solana. While crypto sleeps on the future arrival of quantum computers, the BB84 community is already building an ironclad fortress on chain.

attributes.name: PATRON
attributes.description: PATRON (PAT) is the token of the PATRON platform (Human Asset Market). It is used for creator support, rewards, YouTube lending, OfferPad / DigitalTwin, and trading features including PATRON PERP. Max supply is 1,000,000,000 PAT on Robinhood Chain; a bridged copy exists on Sei via LayerZero (no extra issuance). The canonical Robinhood Chain contract uses 18 decimals. Circulating supply was 94,164,736.96 PAT, about 9.42%, in the 2026-11-06 JST snapshot. The Sei token is a LayerZero OFT bridged copy; an equal amount is locked in the Robinhood Chain adapter, so the bridge does not create additional issuance. The primary market is the PAT/NVDA pool on Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain.

attributes.name: LoopUP
attributes.description: LoopUP is a fair-launch token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Anyone can launch a token on a bonding curve with a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000. When a curve fills, its liquidity moves to a Uniswap v4 pool and the pool position is permanently locked, because it has no withdraw function. LoopUP also runs an on-chain calling system: verified callers, called Loopers, record public calls on tokens and earn on every trade that follows. Every call has an on-chain receipt. LOOP is the native token of the LoopUP platform.

attributes.name: Auren Protocol
attributes.description: Auren Protocol is a language and resource protocol that provides artificial intelligence companies with raw data in various dialects. Its core operational logic involves gathering raw data—derived from dialects spoken around the world—into a centralized pool, which is then sold to AI companies. Users who contribute to data collection or verify the authenticity of the data earn AU tokens, thereby creating an integrated ecosystem.

attributes.name: WAPO
attributes.description: WAPO is a community-driven cryptocurrency memecoin deployed on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20) ecosystem. The project is conceptually inspired by the legacy of early digital asset initiatives like Dogecoin and Shiba Inu, utilizing cultural meme elements and humor within its presentation. The token operates utilizing an image of a Shiba Inu dog wearing a black eye patch as its primary visual identity. It is designed to function strictly as a decentralized parody asset within the broader digital currencies space. The cryptocurrency does not feature a formal developer team or corporate structure, operating instead under a utility model intended entirely for entertainment and community engagement purposes within the Web3 ecosystem.

attributes.name: ConConAI
attributes.description: ConConAI is a network of AI shopping advisors. Each advisor works in one consumption category, such as travel, cars, real estate, film, music, health information and investing research, and runs on its own website. A user describes what they need in plain language, and the advisor answers with one reasoned recommendation instead of a long list of search results. The advisor never buys on the user's behalf; the user always makes the final decision. Businesses can apply to have their products and services considered by the advisors through the partner platform at partners.conconai.com. CON is the ERC-20 token of the network on Ethereum.

Contract address: 0xFfE111D7C370DEC61B56F8C302790765E063aE72 (Robinhood Chain, chain ID 4663), with 18 decimals. Trading pair: Ivy / FOBO on Uniswap V4 (Robinhood). attributes.name: Pumper
attributes.description: Pumper is a permissionless token-launch protocol built on Uniswap V3, on Stable. Anyone can create a token through a fixed, non-configurable process: a set 1,000,000,000 supply, no presale, no team allocation, no custom tax, with 100% of supply seeded as one-sided, permanently-locked Uniswap V3 liquidity at launch. Trading is ordinary V3 swapping at a flat 1% fee with no extra creator tax. Anyone can permissionlessly harvest a pool's accrued fees: the token side is burned to the dead address and the stablecoin side is split between the protocol and a reward pool for that token's stakers. $PUMPER is Pumper's own token and governance asset, and additionally earns holders a stablecoin staking yield and a daily distribution of tokenized gold (XAUt0), both funded by its own pool fees.

attributes.name: The ChampCoin
attributes.description: The ChampCoin (TCC) is a community-driven cryptocurrency project operating on the BNB Smart Chain (BSC) as a BEP-20 token. With a maximum supply of 70 million tokens, TCC is designed to provide a decentralized digital asset within the blockchain ecosystem. The project is maintained and supported by its community, with no single individual owner controlling the overall project. Its activities include token trading through decentralized exchanges, accessibility through compatible cryptocurrency wallets, and the gradual development of practical ecosystem utilities. The project aims to expand the use cases of TCC through blockchain-based applications, payment-related solutions, and integrations with relevant services. Its development approach focuses on community participation, transparency, accessibility, and long-term ecosystem development while preserving the founding vision behind The ChampCoin.

attributes.name: Solidity Brasil
attributes.description: Solidity Brasil (SDBR) is the utility token of Solidity Brasil, a Brazilian developer studio that builds websites, landing pages, AI agents, messaging systems and blockchain tools. SDBR is used to pay for these services. It is a LayerZero v2 Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) deployed at the same contract address on BNB Smart Chain, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche and Celo, with 9 decimals and a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 SDBR minted once on BNB Smart Chain. The entire supply was placed in a Uniswap v4 SDBR/USDT pool on BNB Smart Chain at launch on 6 November 2026; the issuer kept no tokens.

attributes.name: Boinko Coin
attributes.description: Boinko Coin ($BOINKO) is a community-driven Solana memecoin built around the Boinko App at app.boinkocoin.com. The app includes an arcade that runs regular prize drawings and BoinkoTV, a livestream built into the app. The project also runs an official merch shop at merch.boinkocoin.com. BOINKO relaunched on pump.fun on July 20, 2026, migrating from its earlier Moonshot token, and graduated to PumpSwap. It was a fair launch with no presale or team allocation. Mint and freeze authority are disabled, there are no locks or vesting, and the dev wallet is 24CRtTt3xAKfERFZPZjx6gzr2vY4yJPxqdvFGKaUidZv.

attributes.name: bestow
attributes.description: BESTOW (BESTOW) is a token on Robinhood Chain associated with bestow.fun, a gifting application for tokenized stocks. On bestow.fun, a sender selects one of more than 200 stock tokens available on Robinhood Chain, pays in ETH, and the purchased stock token is held in the BestowVault smart contract until it is claimed. The sender receives a single private link containing a one-time key generated in the browser. The recipient opens the link, connects any wallet and claims the stock token, with network fees covered by a relayer. Unclaimed gifts can be reclaimed by the sender at any time. The vault contract has no owner and no admin functions.

attributes.name: Xsolla Gas
attributes.description: Xsolla ZK is an Ethereum Layer 2 network for games, built as a ZK rollup. XLA is the network's gas token. It is an ERC-20 token on Ethereum mainnet with a total supply of 1 billion, and it becomes the base token of Xsolla ZK through the canonical bridge. Every transaction on the network, including claiming a game item, pays gas in XLA, either directly or through XLA-NT, a non-transferable gas credit backed 1:1 by XLA.

attributes.description:
Ah Shit, Here We Go Again ($HEREWEGO) brings the familiar feeling of stepping back into the same alley to Solana. Inspired by an iconic gaming meme, it turns another run, another restart, and another chaotic day into a shared joke.

The website pairs original meme scenes with an interactive bicycle run, giving the community more to explore than a ticker. HEREWEGO is an unofficial parody project with no affiliation to Rockstar Games. Same alley, new run. Here we go again.

Elon added that he aspires to be like JOSE, the one who keeps digging instead of standing on the sideline and commenting. He framed it as a reminder to stay in the dirt, do the hard part himself, and ignore the crowd that only watches.

attributes.name: Bull Time Coin
attributes.description:
Bull Time Coin is a community meme token starring a grinning bull in a black bomber jacket with a white fur collar and a gold watch on his wrist. He doesn't wait for the market to turn. He climbs the clock tower and cranks the hands forward himself.

He's in his trading den at midnight with his boots up and coffee in hand, watching red candles turn green. He's in the bullring at high noon, checking his watch while the bear drops the cape and runs. He's riding a hoverboard out of a time portal, leaving gold coins across every era from dinosaurs to moon bases.

The idea is simple: patience, confidence and timing. Bears panic and bulls wait, and when the clock strikes, the herd charges together. No rush, no fear, just a crowd of bulls who know their time is coming.

attributes.name: SpaceX Inu
attributes.description:
SpaceX Inu (SI) is a community token on BNB Chain that powers the SI Trade Engine, an automated trading system that executes trades from a dedicated on-chain vault wallet. The engine operates across four strategies: meme token trading on BNB Chain, standard leverage trading, a high-volume "Super Candle" mode, and BTC "Micro Events" trading with multi-timeframe trend confirmation. Leverage trades are executed on Binance and OKX through their APIs.

Realized trading profits are distributed in daily rounds: 60% to SI stakers in USDT, 20% to SI buybacks and burns, and 20% to a reserve fund that covers losing days. All vault trades and profit distributions are published on a live public terminal, and each round's distribution is recorded on-chain on BNB Chain.

SI holders can stake their tokens with no lock-up period to receive a share of the USDT rewards. The token has a 3% buy and 3% sell tax that funds the trading vault.

attributes.name: Ensemble VOL Vault Share

Its vault targets short Bitcoin perpetual futures exposure on Hyperliquid equal to six times the vault's net asset value, with a 45% USDC cash reserve target. Automated systems manage collateral and rebalance positions. Share value reflects the vault's net assets, including trading results, funding payments and costs. VOL is a directional short Bitcoin strategy, not a volatility derivative or delta-neutral product.

attributes.description:
DENIM ($DENIM) is a community-driven meme token launched on the Base blockchain through Clanker v5 to celebrate the Base Denim network upgrade. The project takes its name and visual identity from the upgrade, which introduced native 200-millisecond block times to Base.

DENIM features a blue, denim-clad mascot and focuses on community engagement, original artwork, and meme culture within the Base ecosystem.

The token incorporates a holder dividend mechanism through Clanker v5, with 50% of trading fees allocated to distributions for eligible token holders. Holders can view and claim available dividends directly through the token's official page on clanker.world

DENIM is an independent community meme token and is not an official token of Base or Coinbase.

attributes.name: Aurion
attributes.description:
AURION (AUR) is an early-stage digital ecosystem project built around a utility token deployed on BNB Smart Chain (BSC). The token has a fixed total supply of 1,000,000,000 AUR and operates through a verified smart contract.

The project focuses on developing an online marketplace for digital products and services. Planned marketplace categories include graphic design, software development, digital files, education, consulting, marketing, and other digital services.

The marketplace is intended to allow registered users to participate as both buyers and sellers. User registration and authentication have been implemented in an initial prototype, while product listings, transactions, and additional marketplace functions remain under development.

AUR is currently tradable through a liquidity pool on PancakeSwap V2. The project is in its early development stage, and its planned ecosystem features are not yet fully operational.

attributes.name: Apertum APTM
attributes.description: OpenPlaza Bridged APTM (Avalanche), ticker aAPTM, is a receipt token on Avalanche C-Chain that represents APTM locked on the Apertum blockchain through the OpenPlaza bridge. Each aAPTM is redeemable one-for-one for APTM held by the bridge lock contract on Apertum. aAPTM is not native APTM, is not issued by the Apertum Foundation, and is distinct from wAPTM on bridge.apertum.io. Users lock APTM on Apertum to mint aAPTM on Avalanche, and burn aAPTM on Avalanche to release the matching APTM on Apertum. The token contract uses 18 decimals at 0xf0549FE8C622fe46e93eFcAE8A1A1c3c9EbceC4A.

attributes.name: Letronna
attributes.description: Fast open-sourced agent written in Rust, come with built in Wallet, Cloud and Offline models. Deploy anywhere even in your pocket with Letronna.

attributes.name: State of Leonida
attributes.description: State of Leonida (LEONIDA) is a token launched on the Solana blockchain, inspired by the fictional State of Leonida setting associated with Grand Theft Auto VI. The project aims to build a community around the Leonida theme through its website and social media channels. The token is deployed on Solana using the Token-2022 standard and is publicly tradable through decentralized exchanges. Its official website serves as the central information hub for project updates and community resources. State of Leonida is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

attributes.name: Flora
attributes.description: Flora ($FLORA) is a meme token on Robinhood Chain and the official mascot of the floor on fobo.fun. Every token launched on fobo.fun has a floor: a reserve filled by a share of every trade’s fees, which stands as a standing bid for the entire supply at the floor price, with everything it buys burned. Fees only add to the reserve and burns only shrink the supply, so the floor can rise but never fall. $FLORA is the token that represents that mechanic. It has a fixed supply, no mint function, and its creator fees are spent on buying back and burning $FLORA instead of being paid out.

attributes.name: Feast
attributes.description: Feast is a launchpad on BNB Smart Chain where anyone can start a meme coin in about a minute. Each coin trades in its own PancakeSwap Infinity pool from its first block, paired with BNB or with a tokenized stock; there is no bonding curve and no migration step. Every trade pays a 1% fee, split on chain between the coin's creator, a buy-back and burn of the coin, the trader's referrer and the platform, in shares fixed when the coin is created. FEAST is the platform's token.

attributes.name: SynapseAi
attributes.description: SynapseAI is an ecosystem of applications on BNB Smart Chain that includes a web dApp, a wallet, a decentralized exchange and services that accept token payments. SPS is its BEP-20 token, with 18 decimals and a fixed supply of 1 billion tokens. SPS is used for ecosystem payments and liquidity, and trades against WBNB on PancakeSwap V2. Transactions through registered liquidity pools incur a 3% token tax. Collected tokens can be converted to BNB for distribution to eligible SPS holders through the associated rewards contracts. Holders claim available BNB rewards on-chain. Ordinary wallet-to-wallet transfers are not subject to the pool transaction tax.

attributes.name: Wealth Coin
attributes.description: Buy Wealth. Own Wealth. Build Wealth

attributes.name: Phoenix Token
attributes.description:
The platform is designed around sustainability and long-term community value, utilizing a "participation share" model.

Phoenix Token (PXT) is the utility token of the Phoenix Project. It is the currency of that economy: members participate through Participation Shares, and the value those shares produce is settled in PXT.

Participation Shares: Each share is priced at $25 and provides 90 days of production. Renewals are available for $20, with a maximum of 2,000 shares per account.

Phase One (June 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027): Focuses on community growth, utilizing rewards, vouchers, and staking balances.

Phase Two (Starting March 1, 2027): Marks the transition to a permanent operating model where the voucher balance is removed and rewards shift to 1.5% of the investment value.

attributes.name: Aerostrategy
attributes.description: Aerostrategy is a protocol on Base that accumulates sAERO, the staked form of AERO, the native token of the Aerodrome DEX. A fee on AEROSTRAT trades through its main pools funds purchases of sAERO NFTs for the protocol treasury. The treasury's sAERO directs AERO emissions and earns rewards via Aero's predictive allocation, and the voting rewards it earns are converted to USDC and used to buy back AEROSTRAT, which is then burned.

attributes.name: RichThailand Green Nova X
attributes.description:
RTGX is a sustainability-focused ecosystem integrating carbon-credit projects, agriculture, green products and blockchain technology — building a transparent digital bridge between measurable environmental value and the global digital economy.
Environmental action
can create measurable value.
Carbon-credit markets provide mechanisms for quantifying eligible greenhouse-gas reductions, avoidance or removals. RTGX focuses on the digital layer: making eligible environmental assets easier to discover, trace and interact with through blockchain technology.

attributes.name: STEVE
attributes.description:
Steve is a community-driven memecoin built on the Solana blockchain, inspired by the iconic character from Minecraft. The project focuses on bringing internet culture, gaming nostalgia, and cryptocurrency communities together through original digital entertainment.

Steve serves as the central character in an expanding collection of community-created content, including animated videos, memes, short films, and social media campaigns.

The token provides a shared identity for a community interested in cryptocurrency, gaming culture, and digital creativity. Rather than promising financial returns or complex financial utilities, Steve emphasizes entertainment, community participation, and creative expression within the Solana ecosystem.

attributes.name: Gabox
attributes.description: Gabox is a decentralized, on-chain gacha platform built on the Solana blockchain that combines token launches, interactive pack openings, and community participation. The platform allows users to discover and launch tokens through dedicated gacha machines. Each machine is associated with a token and offers packs containing randomized token rewards across predefined prize tiers. Users can open packs to receive different amounts of the machine's associated token, while creators can configure prize distributions and launch new machines. Gabox uses on-chain mechanisms to make pack purchases and outcomes transparent and verifiable. Randomness is provided through MagicBlock, and prize odds are fixed on-chain when a machine is created. As machines progress through their launch process, they can graduate to open trading pools. Gabox aims to introduce a different way to discover, launch, and interact with tokens within the Solana ecosystem.

attributes.name: Faro
attributes.description: Faro (FARO) is the utility token of FAR Action Radar (faractionradar.com), a market-signal platform on Base that publishes algorithmic research reads for gold and crypto, including weekly directional calls, a live track record, and FAR Pulse, an on-chain prediction game. FARO is used for access inside the platform: holders can lock FARO in a verified locker contract to unlock FAR Pro for as long as the lock runs, and receive the full amount back when it ends, with no rewards or fees. Season 1 is running, in which active FAR users (Pulse players, FAR NFT holders and FARO lockers) become eligible for a share of the community allocation. Planned next: paying for memberships with FARO, using FARO in FAR NFTs and games, and holder voting through the FAR Council.

attributes.name: Goldstein Robinhood Chain Index
attributes.description: Goldstein Robinhood Chain Index (gHOOD) is a tokenized fund-share token issued by Goldstein Group on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). It provides holders with exposure to a managed basket of Robinhood Chain ecosystem tokens through a single ERC-20 asset. The live vault holds a diversified set of underlying tokens under a published mandate, including holdings such as CASHCAT, AI, PONS, TIBBIR, HOOKR, WALLET, ORBIO and a USDG cash allocation. gHOOD shares are dynamically minted when new capital enters the fund and burned when shares are redeemed. Holders can redeem gHOOD in kind at any time for a proportional share of the underlying vault assets according to the fund’s smart-contract rules. The token trades primarily against USDG on Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain. gHOOD is distinct from the GLDSTN token and is not an official Robinhood product or endorsed by Robinhood Markets.

attributes.name: Goldstein Global AI Leaders
attributes.description: Goldstein Global AI Leaders (gAIX) is a tokenized fund-share token issued by Goldstein Group on Robinhood Chain. The token represents redeemable shares in an onchain vault that provides exposure to a basket of eight AI-related companies: NVIDIA, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, SpaceX, Tesla, and Micron, together with a USDG cash allocation. The portfolio is managed within published mandate and allocation bands by an agent that operates under clear rules. Holdings, rebalancing decisions, and the mandate are publicly visible. Holders can redeem gAIX in kind for a proportional share of the underlying vault assets according to the smart-contract rules. The token trades on Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain, primarily against USDG. It is distinct from Goldstein Group’s GLDSTN ecosystem token. Market price is not guaranteed to equal net asset value. Goldstein Group is independent of and not endorsed by Robinhood.

attributes.name: memeputer
attributes.description: memeputer makes creating memes and launching meme coins simple and fun. A person brings an idea, an image, a link, a social media post, a video, an existing coin or one of memeputer's thousands of meme templates, and memeputer turns it into a unique meme ready to post or a coin ready to launch in a few clicks. Creators earn 1% on the memes they create and launch, and claim their earnings at memeputer.com.

attributes.name: ABORTMAS
attributes.description: ABORTMAS ($ABORTMAS) is a community-driven memecoin on Solana. It launched fairly on pump.fun on 5 October 2026 and graduated to PumpSwap. Mint and freeze authority are revoked, and about 39.6% of the 961,720,924 total supply is locked via Streamflow. There was no presale, there is no audit, and the team is anonymous. The token is a meme asset with no stated utility beyond community participation and trading.

attributes.name: Grok Mascot
attributes.description: Groklet is a community-driven meme token on Solana built around a teal alien character who loves Earth and pizza. It's a pure meme through and through — no utility promises, no roadmap gimmicks, no claims of affiliation. Just a recognizable character and a community that enjoys meme culture. The project is fan-driven and focused entirely on entertainment and community participation. The project is not affiliated with Elon Musk or any of his companies.

attributes.name: YELLOW
attributes.description:
Yellow is a Web3 infrastructure ecosystem designed to enable decentralized clearing, settlement, and cross-chain financial coordination. It is built around a Layer-3 architecture that combines Ethereum-based settlement with off-chain state-channel execution to support real-time, non-custodial transaction processing.

YELLOW operates as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum. On top of this base layer, Yellow deploys the Nitrolite protocol, a state-channel framework that allows participants to transact off-chain while preserving the ability to enforce final settlement on-chain. Off-chain transactions are cryptographically co-signed by participants, and disputes can be resolved through on-chain smart contracts.

The Yellow Network connects brokers, decentralized applications, liquidity providers, and node operators through a unified clearing framework. Within each state channel, at least one participant operates as a clearnode, providing liquidity routing and blockchain abstraction across supported networks. The ecosystem also includes the Yellow SDK, which allows developers to integrate applications without directly managing state-channel infrastructure.

attributes.name: Rune Keepers
attributes.description: Rune Keepers is a browser-based idle game built on Solana where players summon and manage teams of heroes, send them to hunt monsters, collect KRUN, and develop their characters and equipment. Players can build teams of up to 15 heroes and encounter monsters and bosses across different hunting environments. Heroes have six rarity levels and different skills that affect their performance. The game also includes a Camp and Forge system for recovering hero durability and repairing weapons, as well as a Fusion system that allows four heroes of the same rarity to be combined into a higher rarity. KRUN is the utility token used throughout the game's economy.

attributes.description: return ot tradition

attributes.name: Kyte
attributes.description: The onchain options market on Robinhood.

attributes.name: Prompt
attributes.description: Wayfinder is a non-custodial AI agent for crypto trading. From one chat or trading UI, users trade spot on 13 EVM chains plus Solana, Hyperliquid perps and Polymarket, with limit, stop and TP/SL orders across all. The agent researches markets, scores market-moving posts on X (Signals), screens new tokens (Trenches), runs scheduled jobs and strategies, and is accessible by SMS.
